_meta.note: Modern Standard Arabic in the register of WHO EMRO and Sudan Federal Ministry of Health public-health communication, with Western digits; severity, confidence and connectivity values are masculine adjectives that agree with an implied «مستوى» (level), so insertion slots are written as «مستوى الشدة: …» / «مستوى الثقة: …», counts are phrased as «عدد …: {n}» or «… عددها {n}» to avoid number–noun agreement, «possible» is never rendered «محتمل» (reserved for probable), and «intelligence» is rendered «معلومات وبائية تحليلية» rather than «استخبارات» to avoid security connotations.
